$comment: Every file or folder that exists in two places, read by scripts/lint/copies.mjs (pnpm lint:copies). pin: gt-cloud is the source and this copy is frozen at sha256; a re-sync updates the hash. source: this repository is the source and `copies` names where it was copied. fork: the copies differ on purpose; `from` and `reason` say why, and nothing is compared.
